t: Men's Durango Maverick XP Western Work Boots (DDB0242)
d:
Details 
 This is the men's 11 Western Bay Brown/Steel Cut Oat Durango® Maverick XP™.
 This style features full-grain leather, a soft mesh lining and the Durango® X-Pand System™ which is a hidden gore expansion on the inside medial seam for a universal fit and easy on/off. It also has the Durango X-Treme Comfort footbed with Memory Foam for all day comfort and support and a fiberglass shank for lightweight stability
 The midsole is dual-density with a firmer shock absorbing heel for added stability and a soft shock absorbing forepart for ultimate flexibility and comfort. The rolled shank area and anti-torsion ridged external shank provides added lateral stability and the outsole is multi-durometer rubber with high abrasion outer lugs for high impact durability and softer durometer mid lugs for added flexibility and increased slip and oil resistance. It has a double row sole stitch around the square toe for added durability and a 1 ½ rocker heel.
- Square toe
- Full-grain leather
- Rolled shank area
- 1 1/2" Rocker heel
- Fiberglass shank
- Soft mesh lining
- Double row sole stitch
- Dual-Density Midsole with firmer shock absorbing heel for added stability and a soft shock absorbing forepart for ultimate flexibility and comfort
- Anti-torsion rigid external shank provides added lateral stability
- Multi-Durometer Rubber Outsole with high abrasion rubber outer lugs for high-impact durability and softer durometer mid lugs for added flexibility and increased slip, oil and heat resistance
